scc-10:share-vs-split record — the five storage-condition checks ran against the LANDED shared artifact (FunctionBodySkeleton + FunctionFlowGraph on one memoized FunctionFlowGraphStore bundle) and ALL FIVE PASS: checks 1-3 (structural detach: arena-free Send+Sync+'static NoTypeExpr skeleton/graph; build-time no-type-lowering; query-independent once-per-content-version identity) via flow_graph_is_arena_free_send_sync_static + flow_graph_build_is_deterministic_over_one_skeleton + skeleton_build_is_deterministic_per_content_version; check 4 against the production store via cache_runtime::flow_slice_node_tests::two_demands_one_function_flow_graph_build (build_count == 1 across two demands); check 5 end-to-end through the projector via component_meta_flow_return_admission_tests::return_type_member_demand_loads_only_the_walked_member (side.ts parse count 0, zero dispatch keys naming it). Recorded outcome per SCC-10: the shared implementation is SHARE-ELIGIBLE-AND-EVIDENCED — a shared artifact passing all five conditions is equally conforming; this records evidence, not a sharing preference.

closed:R2-UNAPPLIED-WRITE-EFFECT-SOURCE-ORDER — closed by D13 (rev11.flow): whole-slot `=` writes at VALUE position lower as SliceExpr::Assignment and the evaluator applies them IN EVALUATION ORDER (a read before the write keeps the pre-write reaching, a read after observes it, and a DEFERRED closure read observes it through the statement capture look-ahead); the write-then-read twin `{ a: (x = "s"), b: x }` publishes `{ a: string; b: string }` clean + warm too. The span-comparison suppression stays rejected as unsound. Acceptance: flow_return_tests::flow_return_source_order_object_read_before_write_publishes_clean (with the deferred-read negative flow_return_source_order_deferred_read_still_observes_the_write asserting `b: () => string`). The residual unapplied shapes (compound operators, unselected right-hand sides) keep the UnappliedWriteEffect fail-close, pinned on subCompoundParamWrite.

closed:CONDITIONAL-VAR-BRANCH-JOIN — closed by D13 (rev11.flow): the function-scoped `var` layer joins over the ONE shared FlowFrame product lattice at the if-branch join (join_arm_writes in crates/verter_session/src/project_semantic_dispatch/flow_return.rs) — never a merge over the evaluator locals maps. Every continuing predecessor contributes its reaching definition; a never-assigned path folds its DECLARED authority into the join; a never-assigned path with NO declared authority keeps the ConditionalVarDefinition refusal (tsc TS2454). Acceptance: flow_return_tests::flow_return_branch_var (`any` clean + warm) and flow_return_branch_var_undef (`number | undefined` clean + warm); the one-armed unannotated negative stays degraded (flow_return_conditionally_defined_var_degrades_at_observation). The evolving-let twin (X95_evolving_let_both_branches_join) is re-pinned MatchesChecker.

closed:TYPE-SPACE-OWNER-PROBE-CARRIER-SETTLEMENT — closed by D13 (rev11.flow): owner_scope_answers_frame_name settles a BareRef probe through the shared head-resolution authority at the demand point (Expanded), distinguishing resolved (real collision — fail closed) / genuine miss (owner-absent class/enum names preserve the UNCHANGED unresolved carrier, gate silent) / degraded uncertainty (an authored import with an unresolvable route — fail closed via unresolved_head_is_authored_import). Acceptance: flow_return_tests::flow_return_unanswered_type_space_owner_probe_preserves_unresolved_carrier.

closed:RESIDUAL-NON-CALL-ANY-FABRICATION (non-call half) — closed by D11 (rev11.flow): the shallow value pass of the sole shared flow authority no longer publishes a fabricated `any` clean and warm for ANY non-call form. Two layers close it. (1) The unmodelled-form completeness mechanism (infer_declaration_expression_type_with_completeness / used_unmodeled_fallback, crates/verter_semantic/src/analysis/type_eval_build.rs) had already turned the whole residual set from the old `_ => Ok(Primitive(Any))` warm answer into the typed FlowGap::UnmodeledExpression — the positional marker, zero candidates — so the fabricated-`any` warm publication this debt recorded is gone for every named form. (2) D11 adds the typed publications the named surfaces carry, through the ONE shared dispatch, no per-form resolver and no text heuristics: JSXElement / JSXFragment lower to the whole-form JSX.Element type reference resolved exactly as an authored JSX.Element annotation (the frame gate's Namespace-meaning probe covers a frame-local shadow of JSX; an unresolvable JSX namespace keeps the honest authored-unresolved carrier, never `any`); a `super.m()` callee root lowers onto the heritage surface — SliceCall::OnHeritage: the enclosing class's `extends` expression rides as a gated value type (the root-identifier gate's FrameShadowed carrier when the frame shadows it), the evaluator projects `prototype` + the authored member path for an instance member (the member path directly on the constructor for a STATIC member) through the shared ProjectPath { Navigate } walk — only the demanded member is materialised, never the base's whole surface — and the resolved callee takes the one call sink every other resolved callee takes; a MEMBER-valued optional chain (`maybeObj?.b`) lowers to SliceExpr::OptionalMember: strip each optional link's nullish arms, project the static link through the one shared path walk, union `undefined` exactly when a strip removed arms (a non-nullable base keeps the plain member type; an `any` root keeps `any`; a computed key, a terminal call, or a non-identifier root keeps the rails it always had, write-effect rail included). ClassExpression, ImportExpression and MetaProperty keep the charter's fail-closed branch — the typed gap, never `any`, never warm — because their typed carriers have no spelling in this IR yet (the anonymous constructor type through the class surface, `Promise<typeof import("m")>` through the module-namespace surface, the containing function's own type / the lib ImportMeta surface). The authored-`any` contract is unchanged: `x as any` keeps `any` (the operand-provenance note in the superseded record stands; the authored half is pinned by flow_return_lexical_tests::flow_return_leaf_answered_call_forms_publish_any_not_a_carrier and the semantic-any leaf tests). The `await x` half of the original debt is NOT closed here — it closes at D12 (U6.ASYNC_GENERATOR + U6.CALL_RESOLVE; parked canary flow_return_coverage_tests::awaited_call_return_is_the_awaited_value_wrapped_again). Acceptance (all green): flow_return_coverage_tests::jsx_element_fragment_and_attribute_call_returns_are_not_any, ::class_expression_return_is_not_any, ::dynamic_import_expression_return_is_not_any, ::super_method_call_return_resolves_to_the_base_member (number, clean + warm), ::meta_property_new_target_return_is_not_any, ::optional_member_read_return_is_the_stripped_member_or_undefined (string | undefined, clean + warm; the four fail-closed legs publish the typed positional marker with zero candidates), plus the gateOptionalChain row of flow_return_root_gate_tests::flow_return_unmodelled_form_read_through_a_frame_binding_fails_closed (a MEMBER-valued chain over a FRAME-OWNED root now resolves the root through the frame — `number`, clean + warm — where the leaf rail used to fail it closed; the computed-member / new / tagged / private-field rows keep the fail-closed verdict).

owed:VUE-DEGRADED-ARM-PROJECTION-POLICY — the SUBSTRATE half is landed; the FRAMEWORK POLICY half is owed to the Vue owner. Substrate: a flow-return producer that yielded NO surface now carries its own partial class (`PartialReasonSet::FLOW_RETURN_NO_SURFACE`), distinct from the two degraded-SUCCESS classes whose member set is complete by definition, so a consumer can tell WHICH producer contributed nothing to a MERGED surface instead of only asking whether the assembled surface came out empty. The containment set is a per-consumer `MacroProjectionLane` method, and the axis is whether the consumer DERIVES its output from the value: an option-rendering demand faults, while a names-only (TSX/IDE) demand, the authored-splice TSC lane, the per-MEMBER classification, and the file-level aggregate all contain it. POLICY (owed): what `defineProps` / `defineEmits` should DO when one composed arm yielded nothing — refuse, publish partial, or mark — is a Vue framework rule, not a substrate one. The interim choice landed here is REFUSE, selected as the safe default because it is loud and matches the pre-substrate behaviour; the alternative that must NOT be chosen silently is publishing the sibling arms alone, which ships a module whose props omit a member the checker has with ZERO diagnostics, while the TSX lane splices the AUTHORED macro call so the external checker reports nothing — types and runtime disagreeing in silence. Shapes and checker answers, so the decision arrives with its evidence (all Eq<keyof T, ...>-probed against tsgo `7.0.0-dev.20260526.1` `--noEmit --strict --ignoreConfig`, each with a negative control the checker REJECTS): `defineProps<ReturnType<typeof loopHelper> & { extra: string }>()` keys are `extra | label`; `defineEmits<ReturnType<typeof loopEmits> & { evB: (n: number) => void }>()` keys are `evA | evB`; `withDefaults(defineProps<... & { extra?: string }>(), { extra: 'z' })` keys are `extra | label`; `interface Props extends ReturnType<typeof loopHelper> { extra: string }` keys are `label | extra`. Durable owner: the Vue framework pass after the origin/main merge. Resolution gate: that pass. Acceptance tests already in tree asserting the interim refusal, to be re-pointed by whichever policy is chosen: meta_tests::a_no_surface_flow_return_refuses_even_when_a_sibling_arm_contributes and meta_tests::an_unevaluable_emits_spread_source_refuses_rather_than_dropping_the_event. The PRECISION of the substrate half is separately pinned and does NOT move with the policy: meta_tests::a_no_surface_producer_at_a_member_value_degrades_only_that_member (a producer that yielded no surface for ONE member VALUE degrades that member alone and leaves its exactly-typed siblings intact, including the defineModel and defineEmits twins) and vue_macro_codegen::runtime::lane_containment_tests::only_the_no_surface_class_separates_the_two_macro_codegen_lanes.
